name: Guy Moll
features: olive skin, black hair, dark piercing eyes, sharp young face, high cheekbones, slight wiry build, intense fearless expression
bio: Born in French Algeria to a French father and Spanish mother, Moll won the Monaco Grand Prix in 1934 in only his second season, driving for Scuderia Ferrari. Nuvolari called him the only driver of the age with genuine genius. He was killed that August at Pescara, aged 24, after being caught by a gust of wind at over 220 km/h.
